comment: Central SuperR product identity. Read by package/CMakeLists.txt, package/win32, src/node/desktop/forge.config.js and checked against the GWT and R copies by tools/superrstudio/check-identity.ps1. Internal identifiers (RStudio APIs, rstudioapi version, saved-file formats, .Rproj handling) are deliberately not derived from this file.
